bio.text: Mike Gottlieb represents District 102 in the Florida House of Representatives. Gottlieb was elected in 2018 and served as Minority Floor Leader from 2022 to 2024.
Gottlieb is a criminal defense attorney and lives in Davie.
Gottlieb holds a bachelor's degree in political science from George Washington University (1990) and a law degree from Nova Southeastern University (1993).
